title: Static tutor weights (plan §5, v3.3)
description: Per-deck tutor priorities derived from the combo list AND the win plan: combo pieces weighted by popularity and piece-count leverage (commander pieces discounted — the command zone is always available), route payoffs weighted by how many expressible routes they serve. Consumed by the Phase-5 TutorRanker as base weights; live completion leverage is computed in-game.

derivation.description: Human-readable statement of the weight formula actually used.

weights.description: Card name -> weight in [0,1], descending (ties by name). Cards with zero weight are omitted.

explanations.description: Card name -> why it carries its weight (argmax contribution) — the §7 tutor-audit trail.
